Qualitative reference, not exact ground truth; evaluation-only, never training.

native_verification: Four synthetic triplets verified by SHA/dimensions/shared metadata and exact noisy/GT panel bytes across methods. Native160px, no resizing; synthetic exactGT, real independent AHD reference not exactGT. Four real triplets per arm copied by SHA from completed real reports. Full427/fullGFX and both RawNIND modes also verified; all10 RGB16 files passed full hash/size, actual dtype/shape/sample-depth, sampled code count and sRGB ICC checks.
